title: Network Policy and DNS - Blocking Traffic to CoreDNS
description: In this lab you will diagnose a broken application in a namespace that has a deny-all egress network policy. You will confirm that DNS is being blocked, write a targeted network policy that allows DNS traffic to CoreDNS while keeping all other egress blocked, and verify the application recovers. This lab teaches the critical pattern of always pairing deny-all egress with an explicit DNS allow rule.
